global: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glistens in a white bowl, topped with sliced green onions and menma. The rich, reddish-orange liquid and neatly arranged toppings contrast against a dark, softly lit background.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, slightly reflective table surface with subtle grain and faint scratches visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with speckled orange rim and faint red characters, smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and seaweed, glossy and rich in color.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice has pinkish-white meat, slightly crispy edges, and is topped with green onion and red spice seasoning.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale beige, sliced into thin, slightly curved pieces with visible fibrous texture and subtle caramelized edges.
